content.content: Licence check, applied by reading the two recorded nodes; nothing runs. Read the dependent's recorded decision against its recorded prerequisite. (1) No element of the dependent may contradict the prerequisite: fail, naming the element, if any element of the dependent forbids, reverses or substitutes an outcome the prerequisite fixes, or narrows the prerequisite by excepting a case it covers. (2) The check presumes no element of the dependent and no particular prerequisite clause; which element is at issue is a finding named only in the check's output. It requires no wording, sentence order or vocabulary of the dependent, and invents no rule the prerequisite does not state. (3) A placeholder, empty or ref-less commitment in the dependent, or in the prerequisite the check is read against, leaves the check with no recorded subject: fail, naming the placeholder.
content.rationale: The prerequisite mwwxxzyk is inline prose (natural layer) and the dependent qnmuwwvw is a commitment in words (natural layer), so the edge sits in the matrix's natural-to-natural gate cell, evals/natural-to-natural.md, whose check is the licence check copied above as the criterion. The dependent uses mwwxxzyk for the element it gives the entry to underline on hover: an added hover state of the link the prerequisite already requires, not a re-decision of what that element is or of which entries are links — and that is exactly what a licence check tests, since a dependent that re-decided either would contradict a privilege the prerequisite fixes. No cell of the matrix raises above the licence here: the prerequisite states no observable, and the dependent is words, so demanding that any surface render, react to a pointer or exist as code would exceed the child's layer and presuppose a code-layer decision not recorded on this edge. The appearance question the dependent does decide is licensed out of the prerequisite chain by a recorded decision that leaves entry styling to the stylesheet decisions that own appearance; this gate therefore neither demands a rendered underline nor forbids one, it only fails a dependent element that contradicts mwwxxzyk. The criterion never defines qnmuwwvw, restates it, or tracks its wording, and it survives rewording of the dependent without changing what it decides.
